title: EduTracker
tagline: EduTracker is a system of on-chain attestations to ease the development tracking for money designated to help low-income students' performance
description:
This project combines the expressiveness of TBA and security of Scroll blockchain to ensure the good tracking of the improvement students make through their educational journey after being aided financially.

This is achieved by the professors using our user interface to enter their school grade

Git Repository: https://github.com/JavierAmaya/eth-brussels
how_its_made:
The main technologies were the scroll blockchain to store the on-chain attestations and TBAs for the studen´t's follow-up reports to be backed with actual cryptographically-secure evidence of their improvements based on the help received. 

We provide a smooth UI through our webapp for a professor or equivalent guardian to enter the student's school grades, which are then prepared into an attestation that will be sent to the Scroll blockchain, and form part of a TBA (token-bound-account), which offers a high level of expressiveness on-chain.
